name: Azure Resource Key Enumeration (listKeys)
description: Many Azure services have access keys you can list with a management API: storage, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Services, and others. Those keys are often full control of the data plane, like a password for the resource. Attackers call listKeys to harvest them, then talk to storage or databases directly. This is not a burst of VM creates. It is reading secrets that live on the resource. listKeys from a new identity is credential theft.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
